system.description:
Bag of Flour (Action): With a bag of flour equipped in 1 hand, choose a 10x10ft square in front of you. All invisible (but material) creatures in that 10x10ft square are revealed to you. They cannot remove the flour until a quick rest. Expend your Bag of Flour when you use this.

1 Item Slot · 1gc · Baubles, rulebook p.207
